message: Protected web-session gate. Revoke/Delete already publish a signed Hardware-ID block; v10.0.14 now enforces that block at the game connection itself. The client locates the protected core through the native Windows TCP owner table, moves the browser behind a local reverse-proxy gate, injects a live gate heartbeat into HTML, and continuously verifies the signed online access bundle. A blocked License ID or Hardware ID causes the gate to return HTTP 403, stop forwarding protected game/API requests, replace the loaded page with Access Revoked, persist the revoke lock, and terminate the protected core/browser session. If live verification is lost, the gate returns HTTP 503 and closes the session because offline play is disabled.
